full_page.content:
1945, May 12
The following is a faithful transcription of a handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F. M. Cap. ( from the Photo-copy)
ST. BONAVENTURE'S MONASTERY 1740 Mt. Elliott Ave. Detroit, Michigan (7)
May 12, 1945
Miss Grace Panyard Muskegon, Michigan
Dear Miss Panyard:
God bless you and yours. Almost 10 P. M. I feel that before waiting longer I must at least just thank you for your favor of a few days ago. I noted your request and do hope that the dear Good God may bless those intentions you recommended, I am inclosing a few little badges which I hope you may find good use for . . . Best wishes and God's blessing to all . . Mother Doris, George, Arthur, etc. . Praised be Jesus Christ.
Fr. Solanus O. F. M. Cap.
The original in possession of: Doris Panyard 3248 Maple Grove Rd. Apt. 37 Muskegon, Mich. 49441
